notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Theres been a quick update to the achievements to remove two that ended up being impossible to attain. No one likes impossible achievements! 

They became impossible following updates to make some of the later levels more exciting. I believe a better game experience is more important than two extra achievements.
